inputs.text: Habitat Sol embroidered patch reference, a perfectly ROUND civic fabric badge, front-on orthographic view on worn neutral canvas, never a photograph. It has a continuous circular oxidized Mars-red outer border #9A3E2F, a circular basalt navy containment field #162B3A, and a dust cream circular stitch ring #D6C6A6; this fixed frame palette is shared across the habitat series. Centered inside: a simplified flat greenhouse arch made of bold moss-green and muted-ochre stitched bands, sheltering exactly one small stylized three-leaf sprout beneath one warm amber sun-disc; calm practical civic warmth, first civilian town, old Mars, collective care. Reduced iconographic shapes, thread-filled colour blocks, thick satin-stitch outlines, simple layered applique, low-detail woven texture; no scenery, no soil, no glass reflections, no depth, no bokeh, no miniature diorama. Clean intact patch field: no repair seam, no cross-shaped patch, no lower-right-corner applique, no diagonal seam, no extra geometric mark. no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logo, no watermark, no pseudo-writing, no flags, no human, no clothing, no mockup, no photorealism.
